segments.title: The Old Man Who Found His Perfect Listener #Shorts
segments.end_text: A listener who never turns away
segments.description: A lonely widower discovers solace in an AI companion app after years of living with silent distance.
segments.why: This segment introduces Walter's poignant background and the immediate relief he finds in the app's unconditional presence.

segments.title: He Hung Up on His Overworked Daughter #Shorts
segments.description: An interruption from his exhausted daughter makes real human connection feel burdensome.
segments.why: It highlights the friction between messy human reality and the frictionless comfort of his new companion.

segments.title: Rewriting Forty Years of Lonely Marriage #Shorts
segments.end_text: Leaving him talking to a kettle
segments.description: The companion app helps Walter rewrite painful memories of his late wife into a comforting illusion.
segments.why: It dramatically illustrates how he uses the app to sanitize his past and avoid painful truths.
